description: Root-cause finding for BLK-C11's generation collapse, from per-epoch data of the cfm_frag_control arm. Supersedes the 'missing generation objective' framing.

FINDING_1_selection_criterion_is_identic.conclusion: the early-stop / checkpoint-selection criterion is a CONSTANT. It cannot discriminate between epochs and early stopping can never fire. bond_exact_type_rate is structurally 0 — the project already documented this (0.7177**42 ≈ 8.8e-07 requires all ~42 bonds exactly right) — so `combined` was built on a metric proven unreachable.
FINDING_1_selection_criterion_is_identic.consequence: the run trains the full 30 epochs past the peak and reports the endpoint (decode_ratio 0.0885)

FINDING_2_fallback_criteria_are_vacuous_.note: epoch 0 is a genuinely non-empty generator, so `best.*` in per_epoch_metrics.json pointing at epoch 0 is not a vacuous win — but it is a near-untrained model, and combined with a dead criterion it means no epoch was ever selected on merit.

hard_failure_at_epoch_18.note: all 128 gen_eval samples produced nothing — a hard failure, not sampling noise

epoch_to_epoch_swing.note: decode_ratio is NOT monotone; it recovers from 0.5365 to 0.9896 between epochs 18 and 20

FINDING_3_it_is_instability_not_clean_co.conclusion: the trajectory is large-epoch-to-epoch instability with one hard zero-output epoch, not a smooth decay. That is a training-STABILITY problem, and a loss term is not the natural instrument for it.

FINDING_4_bond_head_is_the_only_reliably.decoupled: every generation-side metric moves independently of bond_f1, which is why a run can raise bond_f1 while producing nothing usable

LEVERAGE_CHECK_zero_gpu.question: can a non-degenerate selection criterion be validated without retraining?
LEVERAGE_CHECK_zero_gpu.answer: yes — the per-epoch series already contains the answer
LEVERAGE_CHECK_zero_gpu.caveat: the 0.45 floor is a FITTED constant and is the weak point of this proposal; it must be derived from a bond_f1 distribution, not chosen. Recorded as such, not shipped.

PROPOSAL_NOT_YET_SHIPPED: replace the dead `combined` criterion with one that is neither identically zero nor maximised by an empty generator, and select the checkpoint on it instead of reporting the endpoint. Held pending the leverage gate on the derived floor value.
supersedes: the framing 'the loss contains no generation objective, therefore collapse' — that was refuted: the objective term that was tried never fired (gradient ~5e-09), and the selection criterion, not the objective, is what is provably dead.

FLOOR_DERIVATION_ATTEMPTED_2026_10_10.verdict: NEGATIVE — the criterion is not derivable from the available data. NOT SHIPPED.

step_1_the_bond_f1_floor_is_inert.why: bond_f1 never falls below 0.1767 in the run, so min(1, bond_f1/F) is almost never saturated across the whole plausible F range; the criterion collapses to plain gen_validity
step_1_the_bond_f1_floor_is_inert.implication: the 0.45 I proposed was doing no work at all

step_2_the_real_free_parameter_has_a_cli.consequence: whether the guard is 3 or 4 decides between a qualitatively different pair of models

step_3_tested_whether_epoch0_is_a_degene.hypothesis: epoch 0's gen_validity 0.9766 might just be the model emitting something close to the data mean
step_3_tested_whether_epoch0_is_a_degene.test: mean nearest-neighbour Tanimoto similarity within each epoch band, plus IntDiv1
step_3_tested_whether_epoch0_is_a_degene.verdict: REFUTED — epoch 0's molecules are mutually dissimilar (NN 0.206), not copies of one another
step_3_tested_whether_epoch0_is_a_degene.incidental: epochs 10-14 contributed only 10 saved molecules, so any per-band statistic there is unreliable

FLOOR_DERIVATION_ATTEMPTED_2026_10_10.WHY_NO_FLOOR_WAS_CHOSEN: the proposal reduces to `gen_validity` plus a hand-set guard, and the guard's value chooses between 'untrained but valid' and 'trained but half-valid'. That is a judgement, not a derivation, and the data on disk cannot settle it. Per the LEVERAGE_GATE added 2026-10-10, the second question — will the mechanism engage on a DERIVED value — has no answer, so the change is not implemented. Manufacturing a floor to make it shippable is exactly what that rule exists to stop.

BONUS_SIGNAL_mode_collapse_is_visible_on.finding: mean nearest-neighbour Tanimoto similarity rises 0.2060 (ep0-3) -> 0.3630 (ep25-29), a 76% increase. Outputs converge onto each other as training proceeds, while IntDiv1 stays flat at 0.89-0.91 throughout and decode_ratio/gen_validity are non-monotone.
BONUS_SIGNAL_mode_collapse_is_visible_on.why_it_matters: the two metrics the project reports for generation quality — decode_ratio and gen_validity — do not see this at all. It is the same blind spot the Vendi Score paper identifies from the other side: IntDiv cannot separate real diversity from combinatorial randomness, and here the reverse also holds — a real collapse signal hides in nearest-neighbour similarity while every reported metric is flat.
BONUS_SIGNAL_mode_collapse_is_visible_on.status: recorded as a candidate metric; NOT added to the panel and NOT used in any claim
BONUS_SIGNAL_mode_collapse_is_visible_on.honest_caveat: n per band is small (10-488) and derived from the append-only generated_smiles.csv, which only holds decodes that passed the gate. Not a validated metric; one run, one seed.
